title: Sort the People
description:
You are given two arrays:

names: an array of strings representing names
heights: an array of distinct positive integers representing heights

Both arrays have the same length n, where:

names[i] corresponds to heights[i]
Task

Return the array names sorted in descending order of heights.

Examples

Example 1
Input:
names = ["Mary","John","Emma"]
heights = [180,165,170]

Output:
["Mary","Emma","John"]

Example 2
Input:
names = ["Alice","Bob","Bob"]
heights = [155,185,150]

Output:
["Bob","Alice","Bob"]
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated values.
The third line contains an integer m.
The fourth line contains m space-separated integers.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 1000
1 ≤ heights[i] ≤ 10⁵
All values in heights are distinct
names[i] consists of English letters
